content: Yarsho Gishshas Gujetti Imettida Woga
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Neni Isra7eele asaas, ‹Ta inttes immana qoppida biittayo intte gelida wode,

xuugettiza yarshos woykko adina gishshas yarshettana yarshos woykko asi ba lo7o qofappe shiishshiza yarsho gishshas, woykko lose ba7aaleta wode shiiqiza yarshota miizappe woykko dorsafe GODAAS intte shiishshandeta; hessa misatiza yarshoy GODAA sawiza yarsho gidana.
Hessa gishshas hessa mala shiishshiza asi wuri issi litiro gidana zayten issi kilo gidiza liiqo dhiillefe munuqettida kaththa yarsho shiishshanaas bessees.
Qasse xuugettiza yarshos woykko hara yarshos ehiza issi issi dorsa laaqqara issi litiro woyne ushsha yarsho shiishshite.
« ‹Dharsho yarshos shiishshiza wode qasse nam7u kilo dhiille issi litironne sayso gidiza wogara zayten munuqidi shiishshite.
Ushsha yarshos issi litironne sayso gidiza woyne ushshu shiishsha; hessi wurikka lo7o GODAA sawizaazinne ufayssizaaz gidana;
« ‹Neni issi mirgo adinas, woykko issifeteththa yarshos, woykko xuugettiza yarshos, woykko hara yarshos shiishshiza wode,
he mirgozara heedzdzu kilo gidiza liiqo dhiillefe nam7u litiro zayten munuqettida kaththa yarsho shiishsha.
Hessaththoka ushsha yarshos nam7u litiro gidiza woyne ushshu shiishsha; hessika GODAA ufayssiza, sawizaazanne xuugettiza yarsho gidana.
Hessa gishshas issi issi mirgo, woykko issi issi dharsho woykko dharsho laaqqa woykko korbe laaqqa yarshos shiishshiza wode issife shiiqiza kaththa yarshoy hessa.
Issi meheppe bollara shiiqiza wode izara issife shiiqiza kaththa yarshoy hessa mala gujettees.
Deren yelettida Isra7eele asaappe issoy issoy xuugettiza yarshonne sawoy GODAA ufayssiza yarsho shiishshiza wode hessaththo ooththanaas bessees.

Sinththafe yaana yeletaan inttenara diza bete asi woykko intte garsan diza hara dere asi oonikka xuugettiza yarsho woykko GODAA ufayssiza kaththa yarsho GODAAS shiishshana koykko izaadeyka intte ooththizayssa mala ooththanaas bessees.
Intte ubbatikka intte giddon diza asa dere asatikka hayssafe yaana layththatan ubbatan hayta wogata issi mala naaganaas inttes bessees; intteninne istti ubbati GODAA sinththan issino.
Inttessinne inttenara diza hara dere asaa ubbaas diza wogaynne maaray issino gido› ga yoota.»
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Neni Isra7eele asaas, ‹Ta inttena kaaleththiza biittayo intte geliza wode,
he biittayn kaxxiza kath ubbaa miza wode he kaththaafe GODAAS imota immite.
Hessika koyro dhiillezappe uketh uukkidi baleppe imettida yarsho ooththidi shiishshite.
Buroppe yaana yeleta ubbaan koyro dhiillezappe ekkidi GODAAS imota shiishshite.
« ‹GODAY Muses immida azazotappe issaa intte erontta moorizaa gidikko,
woykko sinththafe yaana yeletati Muse baggara imettida azazoza polontta aggiko,

hessa mala balay maabaray erontta hanikko issi mirgo ehidi GODAA sawidi ufayssiza yarshonne xuugettiza yarsho izas shiishshetto; wogazi azaziza mala kaththa yarshonne ushsha yarsho izara issi bolla gaththi shiishshetto; hessafekka bollara issi deysha orge nagara yarshos shiishshetto.
Qeesezi kumeththa Isra7eele maabaraa nagara wurso; istti erontta ooththida nagara gaason xuugettiza yarshonne kaththa yarsho shiishshida gishshas istta nagaray atto geetettana.
Ubbayka erontta dishe nagara ooththida gishshas Isra7eele asaa woykko istta giddon diza hara dere asaa nagaray atto geetettana.
« ‹Issi asi erontta nagara ooththiko issi layththa deysha laaqqa ba nagara gishshas yarshos shiishsho.
Erontta dishe nagara ooththidaades iza nagaray atto geetettana mala qeesezi GODAA sinththan iza nagaraa wurso; iza nagaraykka atto geetettana.
Isra7eele deren yelettida Isra7eele asi woykko istta giddon diza asa dere asi erontta dishe nagara ooththidaa gidikko ubbaas diza wogay issi mala.
« ‹Gido attiin Isra7eele dere as woykko hara dereppe beti istta giddo yida asi wozinay erishin nagara ooththida asi wurikka GODAA leqqida gishshas derezappe shaaketti dhayo.
Izaadey GODAA leqqida gishshassinne iza azazota erishe moorida gishshas mulera dhayo; iza gomey izara bo› ga yoota.»
Sambata Woga Menththidi Qaxxayettida As
Isra7eele asay bazzon diza wode issi gallas issaadey sambata gallas mith mixishe oykettides.
He iza oykkida asati iza oykki ekkidi Musekko, Aaroonekkonne kumeththa maabaray dizaso efida.
Isttika iza wosttanaakkonne erettontta ixxiin guuththa wodes qashettiishana mala zabes imettides.
Hessafe guye GODAY Muses, «He addezi hayqqo! Kumeththa maabaray dizasoppe iza kare kessidi shuchchara caddi wodho» gides.
Hessa gishshas kumeththa maabaray bantti diza gutappe haraso efidi GODAY azazida mala shuchchara kurakki wodhides.
May7o Macara Gishshas Imettida Woga
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Neni Isra7eele asaas, ‹Intte may7iza may7os macara kessite; issi issi macaray salo misatiza xilatappe gido; hessaka intte buroppe yaana yeleta ubbaankka aggofte.
He macarata intte be7iza wode ubbaan ta azazota hassa7i ekkidi polite; histtiko intte intte ayfen be7idayssanne intte wozinan amottidayssa kaallidi taappe shaaketteketa.
May7ota xeeran diza macarata intte be7iza wode ta azazota ubbaa polana mala istti inttena qofsana; intteka mulera taas haarettidayta gidana.
Tani intte GODAA; inttes Godaa gidanaas inttena Gibxeppe kessida Xoossay tana› ga yoota.»
